# Jots, the inbox, attachments, --from lists and the board.
$ wk init --store repo --preset general
$ wk jot "Idea: a dark mode"
$ wk jot ""
$ wk jot "A very long first line that keeps going and going well past the seventy character title limit for sure"
write shot.png PNGDATA
$ wk jot "Bug: header overlaps" --file shot.png --file shot.png
$ wk jot "x" --file missing.png
$ wk inbox
$ wk inbox --json
$ wk move 4yrm --when later
$ wk move 4yrm --in inbox
$ wk move 4yrm --in core --when someday
$ wk move yebg --in core
$ wk show yebg
write list.md - [ ] Buy seeds\n* Rake leaves\n1. Fix hose\n\n- [x] Buy seeds
$ wk add --from list.md
write list.md - [ ] Buy seeds\n* Rake leaves\n1. Fix hose
$ wk add --from list.md --json
stdin Sweep the path\nOil the hinges
$ wk add --from -
$ wk add "x" --from list.md
$ wk add --from nothing.md
$ wk brief
$ wk board --out out/board.html
$ wk board
